text:
maya.chen: Quick heads-up - Pivotal Labs agreed to do a customer spotlight. Need: interview scheduling, final quote verification, photo/video release, and permission to use logo in promo. Prefer next Wed/Thu morning PT. Also want a 1-sentence benchmark callout about latency/cost impact.

josh_prod: I can own the recording and edit. Wed 10-11am PT works for me. Will send a short prep doc + recording checklist.

sam_cs: Great - I already asked their engineering lead for a short metric. Draft quote from them: "Switching to Redwood reduced inference cost by ~40% and cut median p99 latency from 520ms to 180ms in-prod." Can confirm with them today.

elena_legal: Need a signed asset/photo release and written OK on the quote wording before we publish. Please send the release; tell them we only need a quick e-sign (1-2 mins). I'll review the quote text once they confirm exact numbers.

priya_marketing: For webinar routing: we'll create a registration page and route inbound leads to a dedicated SDR queue (webinar-pivotal). Can we use their logo + one customer headshot in the hero? Need logo file and brand guidelines.

maya.chen: @priya_marketing yes please queue 'webinar-pivotal' for leads. @sam_cs can you nudge them for logo + headshot? I'll follow up on the benchmark phrasing with them - want it to be short and defensible.

lily_sales: Add me to the routing too (lily_sales). If any attendee ticks enterprise interest, escalate to enterprise-sales@redwood. Also request we include an optional 15-min meeting slot in the registration flow.

josh_prod: Calendar/window options I proposed in the prep doc: 
```
- Wed 2025-07-09 17:00 UTC (10am PT)
- Thu 2025-07-10 17:00 UTC (10am PT)
```
I'll add a Loom option if they prefer remote async recording.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Pivotal Labs Spotlight (recording)" - Wed Jul 9 2025 17:00:00 UTC - invites sent to maya.chen, josh_prod, sam_cs, priya_marketing, elena_legal, lily_sales.

elena_legal: Uploaded the standard asset release here: https://company.internal/legal/releases/pivotal-spotlight-v1.pdf - ask them to e-sign and return. Once signed I can approve the final quote text.

sam_cs: They approved the quote numbers via email thread - I'll paste their one-line approval below and cc the contact on the release: "Confirmed: 40% cost reduction and p99 180ms are accurate for our prod traffic after the optimizations."

maya.chen: Perfect. I'll send the release link to their comms lead and request the logo/headshot. Priya - once you have assets, we can draft the landing + social copy. Keep copy short: 1-sentence impact + 2 key bullets (throughput, cost).

priya_marketing: On it. Draft landing copy ETA EOD tomorrow. Will include an A/B headline for testing.

maya.chen: Thanks everyone - tagging this thread as the single source for approvals. Will post final quote and assets here once signed. :rocket:
